name: io.github.matiasrodlo/sci-open
title: sci-open
description: Search seven open-access sources, verify references, read and cite papers, and see what was missed.

environmentVariables.name: UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact email sent to Unpaywall and OpenAlex. Strongly recommended: without it Unpaywall refuses requests and OpenAlex meters them more tightly.

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAlex API key, free from openalex.org/settings/api. Strongly recommended: without one OpenAlex allows a tenth of a key's daily budget, and searches stop reaching it once that is spent.

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NCBI E-utilities API key, for PubMed. Optional: it raises PubMed's limit from 3 to 10 requests a second, which a busy search can reach.

environmentVariables.name: OPENCITATIONS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OpenCitations access token, for get_citations. Optional: OpenCitations allows 180 requests a minute without one.
